sections.text_helper: Section 40.1 "TAMP introduction" in chapter 40 (Tamper and backup registers (TAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1597.
sections.section_content:
The anti-tamper detection circuit is used to protect sensitive data from external attacks. 32
32-bit backup registers are retained in all low-power modes. The backup registers, as well
as other secrets in the device, are protected by this anti-tamper detection circuit with 3
tamper pins and 6 internal tampers. The external tamper pins can be configured for edge
detection, or level detection with or without filtering.
